reason: A is the stronger proposal because it extends prior crack-mitigation work to a cobalt-free AlCrFeNiSi system and directly tests whether power modulation can jointly reduce segregation, residual stress, and defects, whereas B largely restates the well-established substrate-preheating strategy. A still needs fixed modulation parameters and verification that modulation actually lowers thermal gradients rather than destabilizing the melt pool, so confidence is moderate.
